degree.name: Louisiana Transfer Degree (AALT/ASLT)

sources: Louisiana Board of Regents general education core (39 hours in six areas) and its discipline lists, as published in the University of Louisiana at Lafayette catalog, General Education Curriculum (Board of Regents Core table): English Composition ENGL 101-102 or equivalent; Behavioral Science: Anthropology, Criminal Justice, Economics, Geography, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology; Natural Sciences: Biology, Chemistry, Geology, Microbiology, Physical Science, Physics, including both biological and physical sciences with six hours in the same science; Humanities: Literature, Foreign Language, History, Communications, Philosophy, Interdisciplinary Studies; Fine Arts from the approved list.
Delgado Community College, Transfer Degree (A.A. and A.S.): 60 total hours, 39 in approved general education and 21 in discipline-specific coursework (dcc.edu and the Delgado catalog).

Louisiana Transfer Degree Guarantee: with a C or better in each course and the degree earned, all 60 hours transfer, the general education block is complete, and the student holds junior standing; admission to a specific university or program and major-specific requirements are not guaranteed (latransferdegree.org).
Louisiana Statewide Common Course Catalog (AY 2025-26): the fourth digit of a common course number denotes the credit value of the course in semester hours.
